## Predeclared interpretation

q-accuracy gate versus P3: **0/42** cells pass the required 5% reduction.
Per-DOF cell-MAE constraint: **41/42** cells pass; convergence is no worse in **42/42**.
Amortized end-to-end runtime gate versus P3: **41/42** cells pass (ResNet 20/21; Transformer 21/21).
The full-matrix accuracy and runtime gates are not met. Neural initialization did not show a consistent accuracy gain over P3; per-material results and P0/P3/P5 remain visible in the machine tables.
P5 is listed for each material and all individual attempts are retained in `primary/<material>/per_sample.jsonl`. The historical MLP training duration is reported as the PR43 total; new architecture training is listed by run and epoch in the machine evidence.

## Independent-renderer stress

**BLOCKED_NOT_RUN:** An unidentified active Python process is consuming about one CPU core; the no-disruption rule blocks the remaining CPU-heavy stress fits.
No new independent-renderer profiles were generated or scored in this branch. The historical PR43 stress baseline is unchanged and is not a comparison against the new architectures.

## Provenance and retained evidence

`manifest.json` freezes the source/config/CIF/PR43 evidence hashes before new training. `training_complete.json` records all 42 selected models, checkpoint hashes, epochs and measured training time; `models/**/learning_curves.jsonl` records each epoch. `budget.json` records cumulative GPU training time. Per-sample optimizer attempts include starts, nfev, convergence, bounds, errors and timing. See `literature_matrix.md` and `source_audit_addendum_20261020.md` for task fidelity and license provenance. Raw arrays and checkpoints remain ignored locally.

No statistical significance is claimed. The synthetic gates do not clear the independent real-RRUFF physics gate.

## Execution status and recovery

Overall status: **PARTIAL**. The predeclared synthetic primary matrix is complete for seven materials, two architectures, three seeds, and 77 already-opened PR43 test parents per material (42 trained models; 8,085 per-parent/method/seed rows for P0/P3/P5 and the new neural methods). Historical MLP metrics are separate, read-only PR43 summaries. These reused parents make the result exploratory, not independent confirmation.

The first manager attempt completed training and primary scoring, then stopped while aggregating vectors from materials with different numbers of lattice DOFs. The original `failure.json` is retained. Recovery changed material grouping in the reporting code, verified all saved primary rows and all 42 selection/checkpoint hashes, and regenerated summaries from the saved JSONL. `primary_scoring_rerun` is false; no new profiles were generated and no fit or model selection was repeated.

The saved primary records contain 11,319 optimizer attempts (0 failed attempts; 460 bound-hit attempts), 0 failed rows, and 3 rows with any bound hit. Measured CUDA training was 85.387 seconds; the recorded run elapsed 2310.0 seconds before report finalization. Stress remains **BLOCKED_NOT_RUN** and real RRUFF remains **BLOCKED**.

At the stress gate, unidentified Python PID 42152 was observed using 2.0625 CPU seconds during a 2-second sample; command-line inspection was denied. Its recorded start (2026-10-20T10:11:47) predates the run, but activity during primary scoring is unknown. The CPU wall-time comparisons may therefore be confounded and are descriptive only. No process was interrupted.

Paired-parent bootstrap intervals for refined neural minus P3 q and per-DOF cell errors are descriptive only; they are not significance tests.
